# Grid.js

The JavaScript and CSS in this directory are the Grid.js 6.2.0 distribution
from `https://registry.npmjs.org/gridjs/-/gridjs-6.2.0.tgz`. The archive's
SHA-512 is `1001867c78f21175a1d764f1b3a0e34c69d64e8db6eb06e8c2d32b2c8fb235941a269becd26ef20dcc8ceebf83e1103bad94158ff71f9b011a473feb97183c2c`.
The distribution includes Preact. Grid.js and Preact MIT license notices are
included beside the distribution and in the JavaScript embedded in result
documents. The Preact notice was obtained from the 10.11.3 package specified
by the Grid.js dependency range.
